title: Record Ticket Creation Source
story: As a fulfiller, I want to know that a ticket was created by Agentforce and through which channel, so that I understand the ticket's origin.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a ticket is created by the Agentforce AI Assistant
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is marked with Source = Agentforce

acceptanceCriteria.given: a ticket is created via the AI Assistant
acceptanceCriteria.then: the originating channel (Portal or Teams) is stored and displayed

acceptanceCriteria.given: fulfillers want to filter tickets by source
acceptanceCriteria.when: they use reporting and filtering tools
acceptanceCriteria.then: Agentforce-created tickets can be filtered and reported on

edgeCases: Ticket created via API fallback when assistant partially fails
Source field not editable by non-admin users
Reporting on tickets created across multiple channels
Ticket transferred between queues retains source information
